milkeyway wrote: Hi Les.

When I see this kind of charts where explanation is given about IT's activity. Sometimes I feel that I am on the wrong path or I couldn't catch the IT concept yet.

Any suggestions on how to understand IT activity?

IT's love to feed on breakout traders and S/D traders, keep that in mind and you can find many such places on a chart. also there was an extensive period of talk about ITs, started in IF's journal and then Aaron (i think) opened a dedicated thread for such discussion. have a look, you should be able to find it
posts.fa:
milkeyway نوشت: سلام Les.

وقتی این نوع چارت‌ها را می‌بینم که دربارهٔ فعالیت IT توضیح داده شده، گاهی حس می‌کنم در مسیر اشتباهی هستم یا هنوز مفهوم IT را نگرفته‌ام.

هیچ پیشنهادی برای درک فعالیت IT دارید؟

IT‌ها عاشق تغذیه از معامله‌گران بریک‌اوت و معامله‌گران S/D هستند؛ این را در ذهن داشته باش و می‌توانی جاهای زیادی از این دست را روی چارت پیدا کنی. همچنین دوره‌ای طولانی دربارهٔ IT‌ها صحبت شد؛ از ژورنال IF شروع شد و بعد Aaron (فکر می‌کنم) یک تاپیک اختصاصی برای این بحث باز کرد. نگاهی بینداز، باید بتوانی پیدایش کنی

Hi Anneb5

I believe your post was directed at my post. I didn't mean to confuse you. One thing you will see with QM's is that the shoulder (H or L depending on QM direction) doesn't need to be in the same time period. We can have a big delay before coming back to the QM level. IF has done a video on this, have a look. Here is my chart showing what I see and what I think Les Paul was referring too. This time the complete picture. I'm also still learning so maybe Les Paul can give us some feedback.
